title: SFT LoRA parameter localization atlas (weight-space screening)
phase: Phase 1 — screening only; no causal claim, no behavioral evaluation

base_model.dtype: BF16 (widened losslessly to float32 for norms)

definitions.delta_fro: ||dW||_F via trace[(B_s^T B_s)(A A^T)] with B_s = (alpha/r) B; dense dW never formed
definitions.delta_spec: ||dW||_2 = largest singular value of R_B R_A^T (exact, <=16x16)
definitions.energy_share: module energy / total adapter energy (196 modules)
definitions.norm_energy_share: delta_rms^2 share — dimension-normalized analogue of energy_share
definitions.eff_rank_entropy: exp(-sum p_j log p_j), p_j = sv_j^2 / sum sv^2
definitions.rank90/95/99: smallest k with top-k singular energy fraction >= 0.90/0.95/0.99
definitions.gini: sum_i sum_j |x_i-x_j| / (2 n^2 mean x) over the 196 module energies
definitions.mean_cosine_energy_weighted: sum_m w_m cos_m / sum_m w_m, w_m = ||dW_a,m||_F ||dW_b,m||_F
definitions.dtype: float64 for all Gram / QR / SVD / norm arithmetic; float32 tensor storage
